解：1) 主存为64K×16，低8K为ROM，高56K为RAM 由题得无需位扩展. 
Rom: 8K/4K=2(片) RAM: 56K/8K=7(片) ∴Rom需21片，RAM需7片 
2) 假设地址码为A15~A0，从0000H开始，将A15,A14,A13送至 输出为!Yi形式的3-8译码器
Rom1:CS1=!Y0·A12 
Rom2:CS2=!Y0·!A12 
RAM1:CS3=!Y1, 
RAM2:CS4=!Y2 
RAM3:CS5=!Y3 
RAM4:CS6=!Y4 
RAM5:CS7=!Y5 
RAM6:CS8=!Y6
RAM7:CS9=!Y7.  
地址范围：
Rom1:0000H~0FFFH,
Rom2:1000H~1FFFH, 
RAM1:2000H~3FFFH,
RAM2:4000H~5FFFH,
RAM3:6000H~7FFFH,
RAM4:8000H~9FFFH,
RAM5:A000H~BFFFH,
RAM6:C000H~DFFFH ,
RAM7:E000H~FFFFH,

facts.step_3: Rom1:CS1=!Y0·A12; Rom2:CS2=!Y0·!A12; 地址范围：Rom1:0000H~0FFFH, Rom2:1000H~1FFFH
facts.step_4a: RAM1:CS3=!Y1, RAM2:CS4=!Y2, RAM3:CS5=!Y3, RAM4:CS6=!Y4; 地址范围：RAM1:2000H~3FFFH, RAM2:4000H~5FFFH, RAM3:6000H~7FFFH, RAM4:8000H~9FFFH
facts.step_4b: RAM5:CS7=!Y5, RAM6:CS8=!Y6, RAM7:CS9=!Y7; 地址范围：RAM5:A000H~BFFFH, RAM6:C000H~DFFFH, RAM7:E000H~FFFFH
